title: Fallen Stars fall at night
player_outcome: At night, stars streak down across the sky with a whoosh and a glowing trail, land with a chime and lie glowing on the ground, and vanish at dawn if you don't collect them. This is Terraria's classic early-night errand for Mana Crystals.
design: Verified: nothing in src spawns fallen_star; its description promises it (data/items/materials.json).

New Core Gameplay/Events/StarfallDirector.cs with StarfallConfig (data/config/starfall.json: chancePerSecond, radius, height, speed, maxActive). Loaded like SpawnConfig; ticked by GameWorld during 'tick.events'. It uses a Pcg32 seeded from the world seed.

At night, once per second per player: roll the chance and spawn a 'falling_star' projectile at player ± radius, +height, aimed down-diagonal. It only spawns if the target column is loaded and fewer than maxActive stars are out.
ProjectileHitSpecs 'dropItem' { item, count }: ApplyOnHit(p, null) at terrain impact spawns the dropped item.
ItemDef.FadesAtDawn. GameWorld detects the night → day transition and removes such drops (DroppedItemSystem.RemoveWhere).
Projectile falling_star: visual item (fallen_star), trail #fff4b0, light [15, 14, 8], contact true vs NPCs (modest damage), onHit dropItem fallen_star.
Sounds via SoundEvents: 'star_fall' when one spawns within 60 m; 'star_land' on its HitTerrain.
Command 'starfall now' (CombatCommands or WorldCommands) for tests.
files_modify: data/items/materials.json — fallen_star fadesAtDawn true, glows true
data_changes: starfall.json: chancePerSecond 0.022 (~12 per 9-minute night), radius 40, height 45, speed 18, maxActive 4
falling_star projectile as above; fallen_star fadesAtDawn/glows
tests: StarfallTests: at midnight with chance 1, within 600 ticks ≥ 1 fallen_star drop exists; at noon none; setting dawn removes the drops
Smoke events.cmds: 'time midnight' / 'starfall now' / 'wait 5' / 'assert drops.fallen_star >= 1' / 'time dawn' / 'wait 1' / 'assert drops.fallen_star == 0'
verification: Lavapipe night screenshot with a star streak
risks: Stars landing in unloaded chunks: spawn only over loaded columns; drops in lava are destroyed by the existing LiquidEffects.
